title: Being Error Close Context
description: Close context for a metamorphosis that failed with a thrown exception.

error.description: Fully-qualified class name of the thrown exception.

errors.description: Per-variable semantic validation failures, present when `error` is a SemanticVariableException (or subtype). Absent for any other exception type.

variable.description: Semantic variable (constructor parameter) name that failed validation, or comma-joined parameter names for a cross-field #[Validate] method.

error.description: Fully-qualified class name of the exception thrown by the failing #[Validate] method.

message.description: Message of the exception thrown by the failing #[Validate] method. NOT covered by #[\SensitiveParameter] redaction: a #[Validate] method that interpolates the rejected value into its own exception message (e.g. "Too short: {$password}") leaks it here regardless of `value`. Validation methods for a sensitive variable must keep their message value-free.

file.description: Absolute path to the file the #[Validate] method threw this exception from.

line.description: Line number within `file` where this exception was thrown.

value.description: Value rejected by validation. Omitted when not tracked (e.g. a cross-field failure spanning multiple values); redacted to '[FILTERED]' when the constructor parameter is marked #[\SensitiveParameter]. Only this field is redacted — see `message`.

file.description: Absolute path to the file the exception was thrown from. When `errors` is present, this is the `file` of `errors[0]` — the first failing #[Validate] method — rather than the fixed internal location where the wrapping SemanticVariableException was constructed.

line.description: Line number within `file` where the exception was thrown. When `errors` is present, this is the `line` of `errors[0]`.
